scenicChapters.title: Back to Schönkirchen exit → Lütjenburg gate
scenicChapters.narrative: 63 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it — speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

scenicChapters.title: Lütjenburg gate → Oldenburg coast road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 51 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

kiel-baltic-quiet-villages-loop-and-kiel.story: 644 km round from Kiel - plan on about 11 h 42 of riding. The stops in between: Osten, Oldenburg, Oldendorf and Rickling.

legend-atacama-altiplano-route.story: curated scenic road. salt flats, volcanoes, high desert. A one-way ride of 183 km, San Pedro de Atacama to the finish - roughly 3 h 20 in the saddle.
